verdict.rationale: Plaid documents webhooks that programmatically inform you about changes to Items, so status changes on linked connections do surface (plaid-docs-8). The Dashboard MCP server offers tools for debugging Items (plaid-docs-9). Nothing in the pack names specific expired or revoked statuses, or describes a Link update flow that lets users re-authenticate without relinking. missing for 10: documented error/status codes for expired or revoked links, a documented update-mode re-authentication flow in Link, independent or hands-on corroboration of repair working
